name: Potassium molybdenum bronze, blue bronze
equilibrium_context: Quasi-one-dimensional Peierls charge density wave below 183 K

driven_states.emergent_property: Non-thermally melted metallic state with an unchanged lattice: the electronic order is erased on the sub-picosecond scale while the periodic lattice distortion is still standing - an electronic metallic state within a distorted structure.
driven_states.source: Tomeljak et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 102, 066404 (2009), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.102.066404
driven_states.caveat: Purely transient, not a hidden state in the strict sense. Included as a reference case for the decoupling of electronic and structural order in a quasi-one-dimensional system. Despite decades of work, no long-lived hidden state analogous to 1T-TaS2 has been reported in K0.3MoO3.

threshold.quantity: absorbed energy density equal to the electronic energy difference between metal and CDW

sources: Tomeljak et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 102, 066404 (2009), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.102.066404
gaps: Fluence given as a range, not documented as a single value.
